title: Uses character weight and character spacing to distinguish product codes
goal: Controls font-weight and letter-spacing at a specified font size.
summary: device code needs to be viewed verbatim. Increase the font weight of the coded lines and increase the letter spacing appropriately, but keep the general description as it is.
tasks: Set the font size of .serial to 16px, the font weight to 600, and the kerning to 2px.
The description paragraph maintains the original font weight and spacing.

example.note: Kerning is the extra distance between characters, which can be adjusted with the font size using em.

hint: uses letter-spacing to control character spacing, and line-height for line spacing.
